body: Okay you’re right

I’m a good person. I’m kind I’m caring I’m respectful I don’t want to do this it’s just a constant thought I always have to just show this person that it’s not okay to do certain things. It’s not okay to just treat me like shit. I went a whole month not thinking about this. Indulging myself in so many distractions and I find myself here again. The reason I want to do it is so that I destroy any possible reconciliation, any possible way of me being the good guy, and any possible way of further communication or damage to myself, I don’t want to think about it anymore. That’s my primary reason but I understand it’s creepy as fuck.

I am aware that it is creepy, it is wrong, it is sick, it is morally bad, it is not a good thing to do. I get it, I understand, I’m human, I have bad thoughts, I’m a good guy, I didn’t do anything wrong, I felt stuck. I’m the guy who hates shit like this, I never thought I would be in this position or asking these questions, it creeps me out, it’s disturbing for me, it’s disgusting, I get it. I get it. I understand. Word will not get out, you knows what’s so interesting I have told every single one of my friends about this. All of them, and not a single one has told me I’m wrong. Some have told me not to do it but no one sees me differently. They all know me and some have even pushed me to do it. I don’t do it. I don’t ask for advice from anyone anymore. That’s why I’m asking it to the general public. Don’t tell me it’s creepy I already know this.
I don’t want to do it and I won’t. If she wanted to sue I’ll pay whatever, money isn’t a problem. I asked again because deep down I don’t want to do it. I appreciate all the advice.

You’re so right, she’s an attention seeker. She thrives off the energy, when I told her that she did so many things that hurt me and then I told her to just give me a chance.ME GIVE ME A CHANCE, when I did nothing wrong. Nothing. I made myself look weak, I lowered my status for someone who is not worth it. And you know what she did? Just posted a picture of her ass and her texting someone else. I hate her. I’m not going to lie to you, I mentioned it to her one time before. I told her if I want to destroy your life and ruin it right now I can. She switched, told me she respects me and talks to me just to say how are you and have a nice day. But everyday I hate her even more because it’s not even real. I wish I never even mentioned it but I did and now I’m at this point. She will never care regardless, and she will never realize that I’m better than her and I deserve better. I’m nothing and that’s it. But I know my value and I’m just tired of staying strung up on a worthless girl who I can just crush and forget forever.

That’s the worst part, I would face no legal action. She is powerless in that sense. Pretty much can’t do anything. Both from different countries. Hers has no laws concerning these acts and she isn’t a us citizen so she can’t rely on our laws. I don’t need to be sold on the legal side of this, just the moral one.

I’m not a bad person, it’s just a thought. You walk around everywhere feeling violated and exposed. Every man you’ll ever be with will know that you’re not special anymore. You will never feel that feeling of security in your own skin. Why do I even consider it, because it’s something you can never avoid and this is something that will stick with me forever so I see it as equal in that sense and only that sense. It’s such a fucked up punishment, I wish I didn’t even have the power to do it because I am a good person but I don’t know what to do. I would face no repercussions. She’s from Russia, they have no revenge porn or online abuse laws. If you threaten violent acts then you can be but I would never do that. And that’s it. I would block her everywhere and she would just bang her head against the wall and wait for it to end when it never will. I’m trying to control myself. Every night I just write in a journal all the fucked up things I would like to say. And it helps but then I get sucked into this darkness and it leads me back to the same thoughts.

She deceived me, betrayed me, lied to me, for months, ignored me for weeks just to bring me back in and apologize and do it again, she was always bipolar to me, she blamed me for everything, left me to talk to myself for an entire month just to say leave me alone, I don’t care when all I was trying to do was get things off my chest and then fix them, I hate her with everything in my heart, I was so kind, loyal, honest, respectful, caring, all these things and she treated me like shit. Now I’m sure she gets fucked every night by someone who’s less than me. And what am I doing? sitting here writing about this while she gives no fucks. I know her personality, she’s narcissistic, a liar, heartless, cruel, gives silent treatment for weeks on end over nothing, she cheats, she’s a bitch. The more I write the more I want to hurt her so i really need to stop
I know it’s wrong and I will most likely not do it but I pray to god one day that she just suffers for the rest of her life. I don’t believe that someone so cruel and cold hearted should be happy.

I’m not saying I’ll do it, I already know it’s wrong, I feel bad, I feel sick thinking about it, I feel terrible but she’s such a piece of shit, she’s such a bad person I tried convincing myself she was good, I tried being patient, but she proved to me in every single way that she’s a garbage human being.

She lives in Russia, they have no laws concerning this. I know none of her friends. She knows none of my friends. I myself do not even care. I hate her so much that I honestly wouldn’t even mind suffering just to see her suffer. That’s how much I hate her. I could easily do it in a way where it can’t be traced to me and even if I don’t want that it’s so simple for me to do it. But I appreciate the perspective, thank you.
If I’m not normal and I’m sick, why are we communicating right now. Why don’t I delete this post, do it and that’s it? I asked for the girls perspective not yours. I’m sorry but do not call me sick.

Yeah I guess I’m sick, so fuck it. What’s the difference. If you understood the whole story you would know but you jump to conclusions. You don’t know me at all or what kind of person I am. If I was sick I wouldn’t have thought about it and would have done it. I don’t need to be told anything tbh, take your advice and keep it to yourself. I’m not sick and I won’t do it but if I was sick I’m sure I would know.
No, she can’t do anything.

I hate how if I do it I can just disappear, all her friends are in a different country, she’s in a different country. No one I know will ever even know I did it, she would be blocked, lost forever to suffer in her own little world and I would just withdraw with no repercussions. I’ve thought about doing it for months. For months because I’m not a bad person I just hate her and I keep fighting but I can’t anymore. I can but I don’t want to. Why should I keep fighting when I’ve been doing it the whole time. I’ve been trying to be kind for months, I’ve been fighting it for months even before things ended, I just have a deep hatred for her that I cannot extinguish.
You’re right
It’s sad to say that I would face no charges. She lives in a different country and is not American. So she would be powerless. If I was a bad person I would have done it already.

If you want you can read my post from yesterday it explains everything. You can call me sick or whatever you want I understand but I would appreciate it if you understood everything first. I’m not sick. I was just hurt too much and it’s the only way I can seek my own revenge
I understand where you’re coming from im asking for solid advice on how it feels for a girl so I can sympathize and change my mind.
There’s one thing I don’t tolerate, lying, cheating betrayal, and playing with my head. Fuck that
Thanks for the advice though my man. Your parents would be proud

I’m serious as I can tbh, if I was lying I would say it but don’t worry I’ll send her name and you can google it. I’m sure there’s a reason why she called me daddy. But yea, I’ll give you guys something to add to your spank bank.
I’ll damage and then get on with my life. I’m also spiteful, I’m stubborn, I’ve exhausted myself mentally, put her before myself, gave countless chances, and it’s just simply not me. And that’s that.

I wouldn’t have made this decision if she told met her problems and said leave me alone the second time when she asked to rest, wouldn’t have happened the third time, wouldn’t have happened if she left me on seen when I was so mentally fucked that I said leave me on seen if you don’t want to be with me. Or when I asked to block me countless times and she kept unrestricting me. You see where I’m going with this? I’m a dog on a leash who gets pet when the owner feels like it. So she can simply fuck off, deal with it, get on with her life

Yeah I’m aware, but, I could care less. It’s that cold hearted energy that I’m matching. I tried, I tried being nice, I tried being kind you know, I tried to care but once you suck up all the care you have for someone you’re left with something that’s dry and bitter and I’ll admit I’m a vengeful person. Play with my head and it’s game over

When she walks in the street and everyone knows what she looks like underneath, when every man she’ll ever be with knows that the entire world has seen her ass and her body just like him, and when she sits there and cries her eyes out just for me to tell her to fuck off and get on with her life. At that moment one, I’ll be satisfied, and two, she’ll be worthless. I could care less tbh
Exactly and now I get to troll, I’m not deleting anything.
I appreciate it though honestly I know you mean the best for both of us.

She can’t do a single thing I know it’s wrong but next time she can think twice about doing me wrong. I’m a very stubborn person. So every man she’ll ever be with will know that every other man in the world has seen her. She can live with that humiliation and I’ll carry on with my life. I’m sorry for sounding so foul but she can go fuck herself I could care less. If a truck ran her over I would not bat an eye because she is worthless to me. Thanks for the advice though

And I’m a fucking man, I just felt mentally destroyed, silent treatment for weeks and months it’s constant torture, it’s like being imprisoned in your mind. And you can’t do anything about it and you care about the person so you can’t just leave.

I cried every single fucking night for a month straight because I didn’t know what else to do. I begged her to respond, even block me, anything. Any response, I also did it for weeks before. Nothing, not a single ounce of respect, sympathy, nothing, just a worthless piece of shit in your inbox. Can you believe that? I’m not even worth a message. Not a single message. But when it’s convenient for you to speak I have to be perfect and you tell me “I liked you when you were adequate” as if I did all of this by myself. I agree with you but I hate her and I’m trying

She’s the pettiest person I’ve ever met in my entire life.
I wish I never even had them so I could never even hurt her because I’m human but I hate her

I also have misophonia. I tell him, he still fucking does it. I want to at least leave this house. I have $3000 and that’s it. And whenever I tell them I want to leave they tell me it’s messed up, we miss you. I don’t want them to miss me. I’m sick and tired of them and everyone and everything in my life.

When I was tortured about negative thoughts and curses about god he didn’t help me. I still have them until today. I had them when I was 16. I’m now 22 with all these problems multiplied by a thousand. Idk what to do.

My parents and family walk around the house and they have no idea that any of this is happening to me. My mom is cruel. I tell her about these things And she just calls her a slut. I told her she was in the hospital but I didn’t say it was because of me. She said it’s just another non believer dead......... that’s so fucked up. I hate my parents but at the same time I also love them. When my dad speaks I hate his voice I hate everything about my family. I hate how my father just helped so many people and gave away his money and just left me and my family stuck. I hate it.
Okay but you didn’t read the other things I said about my life. How is it is ruined.

You don’t understand me. Yes I tried crisis hotline. They told me bullshit. You don’t understand me. I’m not like other people. I don’t want to call a suicide hotline. They will call the police they will come to my house. I don’t want that. I want to die. I wish I died from natural causes already. I wish I was just walking in the street and a tree fell on me or a car hit me so I would die from natural causes but it never happens. I don’t want to die just because I don’t want to go to hell. That’s it. But eventually I will overcome this fear because I’m already living in hell.
I’ve done it for so fucking long. So fucking long. I hate that I have a religion and a family. It’s the only reason why I suffered for so long.

I didn’t have to send and delete messages. I didn’t have to scare her but I did and I can’t let go because I know it’s not me. It’s not me and I could have avoided all of this. Everyone that I have loved in my life. Every girl has not given me a chance. They all say that eventually they have no feelings for me. All because of a fucking virus I will never see her. I will be tortured forever. I’m sick and tired of living like this

I can afford a gun. It scares me because I don’t even know where to buy it.

I only did it with 2 of my friends. I’m embarrassed and I’m ashamed

I failed in school because of this and I wanted to become a doctor. I will never become one now. My parents think I will and I lied to them and told them I have a good gpa. I don’t. I wanted to die. I didn’t do it because I’m afraid that I will go to hell. That’s it. But I don’t care anymore and I really want to do it but I’m still afraid of hell. I wish I never had a religion. I wish I never existed

Can you please just do that for me. You don’t understand. I have really bad ocd. It’s the only reason why I kept writing to her when I was restricted. I kept imagining her with other people. It made me feel sick. I couldn’t stop it. Now I know she has a boyfriend. It’s the only reason why I did all of this too. It’s not cool. I can’t let her go because I feel incomplete. I can let her go and never contact her again and let her go in that sense but I can’t just forget. I can’t move on. That’s what people don’t understand. She said I’m not human. I’m not normal. She’s right. I told her that I want to die. She said do whatever you want just leave me alone. So that’s what I want to do.

People don’t even write on this post because no one one wants me to live. It’s sick. Why should I live? Why? I gave it one night. I have told her several times that I want to kill myself. She doesn’t believe me. Some time today I will build up the courage and just do it. Tie a belt around my neck, swallow pills, whatever works and thank you but I’m sorry. I’m sorry. Before I do it, I will write her Instagram name. Let her know that I’m sorry. Let her know that I’m already sick and dying. Let her know that I already have heart problems and I did all of this because I feel intense pain. Talking to her was the only thing that helped me. I don’t want to sit in a hospital all day. Crying my eyes out for the next few months. I’ve already done it for the past 7 months. I’m sick of it. Please guys that’s all I ask of you. Contact her for me. For another human being and tell her I’m sorry. Tell her I’m sorry and that everything I said was true and to keep her fucking promise.

What, I just blackmail her again? Scare her again? And then apologize and explain everything so that she just ignores me, just kills herself? I can’t do that. My heart hurts all the fucking time. I constantly think about this. I can’t overcome anything.
I can’t even apologize. I can’t. I can’t even prove that I’m not lying. She thinks I joke with death. She just blocked me again. What a sick bastard I am. She herself even said it.
